i18n.smoke: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} missing
wacz/required-files.desc: WACZ §5.2 requires these files/directories to exist
wacz/required-files.missing-datapackage: datapackage.json is missing (WACZ §5.2.4: MUST exist at the root)
wacz/required-files.missing-pages: pages/pages.jsonl is missing (WACZ §5.2.3: MUST be present)
wacz/required-files.missing-archive: archive/ has no WARC file (WACZ §5.2.1: MUST contain at least one .warc/.warc.gz)
wacz/required-files.missing-indexes: indexes/ has no index file (WACZ §5.2.2: MUST contain at least one .cdx/.cdxj/.idx)
datapackage/profile-required.invalid-jso: {entry} is not valid JSON or not an object
datapackage/resource-hashes.desc: datapackage.json resource hashes must match the WACZ contents
datapackage/resource-hashes.no-resources: {entry} has no "resources" array (or it is empty)
datapackage/resource-hashes.invalid-path: {entry} resource is missing or has an invalid "path"
datapackage/resource-hashes.resource-mis: Resource "{path}" listed in {entry} is missing from the WACZ
datapackage/wacz-version-required.desc: datapackage.json must declare a non-empty wacz_version
datapackage/frictionless-schema.desc: datapackage.json should conform to the Frictionless v1 schema (auxiliary)
datapackage/frictionless-structure.desc: datapackage.json must declare a non-empty resources array; each resource needs name and path (or data)
datapackage/frictionless-structure.no-re: datapackage.json has no resources (a non-empty resources array is required)
cdxj/index-recognised-by-wabac.desc: WACZ must contain a wabac-recognised index (.cdx / .cdxj / .idx)
cdxj/index-recognised-by-wabac.no-index: No wabac-recognised index file found under indexes/ — wabac.js needs at least one .cdx / .cdxj / .idx entry to serve any URL
cdxj/index-recognised-by-wabac.missing-p: {name} references "{pair}" but no such entry exists in the WACZ
cdxj/index-valid-data.desc: index CDXJ (plain or gzipped) must contain valid CDXJ data (WACZ §5.2.2)
cdxj/index-valid-data.invalid: {entry} line {line} is not valid CDXJ ({reason}) (WACZ §5.2.2: index files MUST contain CDXJ data)
cdxj/index-valid-data.gzip-error: {entry} is named as gzipped but could not be decompressed (WACZ §5.2.2: index files MUST contain CDXJ data)
cdxj/index-not-gzipped.desc: indexes/index.cdxj must not be gzipped (wabac.js silently ignores .cdxj.gz)
cdxj/index-not-gzipped.gzipped-entry: Entry "{name}" is a gzipped CDXJ — wabac.js does not recognise .cdxj.gz / .cdx.gz
cdxj/index-not-gzipped.gzip-magic: {entry} starts with the gzip magic bytes — the file is named correctly but the content is compressed
cdxj/filename-archive-relative.desc: indexes/index.cdxj entries must use archive-relative filenames (not "archive/...")
cdxj/filename-archive-relative.starts-wi: {entry} entry "filename" starts with "archive/" — wabac.js prepends archive/ itself, double-prefix breaks replay
cdxj/warc-offsets.desc: indexes/index.cdxj offset/length must land on a WARC gzip-member boundary
cdxj/warc-offsets.missing-or-nonnumeric: indexes/index.cdxj line {line}: offset / length missing or not numeric
cdxj/warc-offsets.offset-no-match: indexes/index.cdxj line {line}: offset {offset} does not match any WARC gzip-member start
cdxj/warc-offsets.length-mismatch: indexes/index.cdxj line {line}: length {length} does not match WARC member at offset {offset} (actual {actual})
cdxj/pages-mainpage.desc: datapackage.mainPageURL must appear in both pages/pages.jsonl and indexes/index.cdxj
cdxj/pages-mainpage.not-in-pages: datapackage.json mainPageURL "{url}" is not listed in pages/pages.jsonl
cdxj/pages-mainpage.no-cdxj-record: datapackage.json mainPageURL "{url}" has no record in indexes/index.cdxj
warc/storage-store.desc: archive/data.warc.gz must be stored with method STORE (0), not DEFLATE
warc/storage-store.zip-compressed: {entry} is zip-compressed (method {method}) — should be STORE (0) so CDXJ offsets seek correctly
warc/members-independent.desc: archive/data.warc.gz must concatenate independent gzip members
warc/members-independent.no-members: {entry} contains no gzip members (empty or unrecognised)
warc/members-independent.decode-failed: Failed to decode gzip member at offset {offset} (length {length})
warc/payload-digest.desc: WARC records' WARC-Payload-Digest must match a fresh sha256 of the payload
warc/payload-digest.non-sha256: WARC record #{memberIdx} uses non-sha256 digest "{algo}" — not verified
warc/payload-digest.no-http-body: WARC record #{memberIdx} ({recordType}) has WARC-Payload-Digest but no parseable HTTP body
warc/recording-complete.desc: browserhive: surface how many recorded requests were incomplete/failed (WARC metadata records)
warc/recording-complete.incomplete: {incomplete} of {total} recorded requests are incomplete or failed ({percent}%)
fuzzy/valid-json.desc: fuzzy.json (when present) must parse as '{' rules: [...] '}'
fuzzy/valid-json.not-object: {entry} top level must be an object
warc/extension-gzip-match.desc: archive WARCs must use .warc.gz when GZIP-encoded and .warc otherwise (WACZ §5.2.1)
warc/extension-gzip-match.gz-needs-gz-ex: {entry} is GZIP-encoded but does not use the .warc.gz extension (WACZ §5.2.1: GZIP WARCs MUST use .warc.gz)
warc/extension-gzip-match.plain-has-gz-e: {entry} uses the .warc.gz extension but its content is not GZIP-encoded
pages/page-schema.desc: each pages/pages.jsonl page line must be valid JSON with url and ts (WACZ §5.2.3)
pages/page-schema.not-json: pages/pages.jsonl line {line} is not valid JSON
pages/page-schema.missing-prop: pages/pages.jsonl line {line} is missing required properties: {props}
datapackage/digest.desc: datapackage-digest.json should be present and its hash must match datapackage.json (WACZ §5.2.5)
datapackage/digest.absent: datapackage-digest.json is absent (WACZ §5.2.5: SHOULD be included to verify datapackage.json)
datapackage/digest.hash-mismatch: {entry} hash does not match the actual datapackage.json sha256
wacz/reserved-dirs-clean.desc: no custom files may be added to the reserved archive/ indexes/ pages/ directories (WACZ MUST NOT)
wacz/reserved-dirs-clean.unexpected: {entry} is an unexpected file in the reserved "{dir}" directory (WACZ MUST NOT add custom files there)
datapackage/resources-complete.desc: every file in the WACZ must be listed in datapackage.json resources (WACZ MUST)
datapackage/resources-complete.orphan: {entry} is not listed in datapackage.json resources (WACZ MUST list all additional files)
